entries.name: Swimming pool
entries.description: A 30m by 30m full-envelope pool garden: large muted turquoise rectangular basin approximately 14m by 10m, two broad lane marks, cream paved edge. Behind it a 16m long by 4m deep one-storey changing pavilion, 3m wall height, muted brick and slate roof, two 2.1m personnel doors, two broad windows. Sparse broad shrubs only. Expand equipment spacing, paths and planted groups across the 30m envelope; add architectural wings where appropriate without changing any human-feature height.
